declare
 cursor c1 is
 select donation_type,procedure_code,sum(goal_count) goal_count
 from goals
 where goal_type = 'STGOL' --decode(:s_option,'A','INGOL','F','FXGOL','M','FLGOL')
 and goal_start_date = :fixed_sites.coll_date
 and goal_end_date = :fixed_sites.coll_date 
 and goal_custodian = :fixed_sites.site_id
 group by donation_type,procedure_code;

begin
 :global.src_item := :system.cursor_item ;

 :ctrl_block.s_goal_date := :fixed_sites.coll_date ;
 :ctrl_block.s_goal_custodian := :fixed_sites.site_id;
/*
 if :s_option = 'A' then
 :s_goal_custodian := 'Institution Goal' ;
 elsif :s_option = 'F' then
 :s_goal_custodian := 'Fixed Goal' ;

*/

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 rg_name varchar2(40) := 'TEMPDATA' ;
 errcode number ;
 query_string varchar2(1000) ;
BEGIN 
 if :ctrl_block.start_date is null then
 go_item('ctrl_block.start_date');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.end_date is null then
 go_item('ctrl_block.end_date');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :system.block_status = 'QUERY' then
 return ;
 end if ;
 message('Working...',no_acknowledge);--pitss synchronize;
clear_message;
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF not Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 delete_group(rg_name) ;
 END IF;
 query_string :=
 ' select coll_date,d.location_id site_id,l.location_name location_name,sum(decode(unit_id,null,0,1)) act_drw,'||
 ' sum(decode(unit_id,null,1,0)) act_def from donations, drives d,locations l '||
 ' where coll_date between :ctrl_block.start_date and :ctrl_block.end_date '||
 ' and exists (select '''|| 'x'''||
 ' from drives where drives.drive_id=donations.drive_id '||
 'and location_id = nvl(:ctrl_block.site_id,location_id) ) '||
 ' and donations.drive_id = d.drive_id ' ||
 ' and d.location_id = l.location_id '||
 ' and d.chapter_id =:global.chapter_id';

 query_string := query_string||' group by coll_date,d.location_id ,l.location_name ' ;
 rg_id := Create_Group_From_Query( rg_name, query_string) ;
 
 errcode := Populate_Group( rg_id ); 

 if get_group_row_count(rg_id) = 0 then
 show_error('9188') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 else
 first_record ;
 for i in 1..get_group_row_count(rg_id) loop
 :fixed_sites.site_id := get_group_char_cell(rg_name||'.site_id',i) ;
 :fixed_sites.location_name := get_group_char_cell(rg_name||'.location_name',i) ;
 :fixed_sites.coll_date := get_group_date_cell(rg_name||'.coll_date',i) ;
 :fixed_sites.act_drw := get_group_number_cell(rg_name||'.act_drw',i) ;
 :fixed_sites.act_def := get_group_number_cell(rg_name||'.act_def',i) ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
 delete_record ;
 first_record ;
 end if ;
 set_control_block_items('D');
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-RECORD-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 rg_name varchar2(40) := 'DONPROCDATA' ;
 errcode number ;
 query_string varchar2(1000) ;
BEGIN 
 if :fixed_sites.coll_date is null then
 return ;
 end if ;
 if :fixed_sites.act_drw = 0 then
 go_block('DONATIONS') ;
 clear_block ;
 go_block('FIXED_SITES');
 end if ;
 go_block('DONATIONS') ;
 :donations.site_id := :fixed_sites.site_id;
 rg_id := Find_Group( rg_name ); 
 IF not Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 delete_group(rg_name) ;
 END IF;
 query_string :=
 ' select donation_type,procedure_code,count(*) actual_draw from donations '||
 ' where coll_date = :fixed_sites.coll_date and unit_id is not null and chapter_id =:global.chapter_id'||
 ' and exists (select '''|| 'x'''||
 ' from drives where drives.drive_id=donations.drive_id '||
 'and location_id = :fixed_sites.site_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ) ';
 query_string := query_string||' group by donation_type,procedure_code ' ;

 -- :qry := query_string ;

 rg_id := Create_Group_From_Query( rg_name, query_string) ;
 
 errcode := Populate_Group( rg_id ); 

 first_record ;
 for i in 1..get_group_row_count(rg_id) loop
 :donations.donation_type := get_group_char_cell(rg_name||'.donation_type',i) ;
 :donations.procedure_code := get_group_char_cell(rg_name||'.procedure_code',i) ;
 :donations.dp_count := get_group_number_cell(rg_name||'.actual_draw',i) ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;
 delete_record ;
 first_record ;
 go_block('FIXED_SITES'); 
END;

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026)
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 format_error;
 elsif error_code in ('0','40209') -- invalid format
 then
 format_error;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;
